quality_hypothesis: A short decision using only visible requirements and explicit exclusion checks permits empty output and improves specificity; bounded visual/context input reduces memory pressure and full latency

candidate.exception_gate: accept only explicit absent; present or unknown is not positive evidence
candidate.evidence_decoding: single PTS-aware pass for all accepted events
candidate.other_coarse_events: retain independently qualifying events; refine highest-confidence event only and discard it if not confirmed

stopping_rule: One architecture candidate. No threshold/rule/model selection using repeated TUNE. If gates fail, report failure and retain the measured baseline; no holdout access.
limitations: The candidate changes multiple resource parameters as a bundle. A speed gain cannot be attributed separately to temporal refinement, lower resolution, compact output or batching without an additional declared ablation. Small repeated exploratory TUNE cannot establish statistical non-inferiority.
